label: 3D Reconstruction
description: Build a compact, georeferenced, web-ready 3D model (GLB) from a task's outputs: a textured terrain mesh from the DSM/DTM or point cloud with the orthophoto (or point colours / shaded relief) as texture, or a web-optimized version of the existing ODM textured model. Detects the available inputs and picks the workflow automatically.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: auto: optimize the existing ODM model when the task has one, otherwise build a textured terrain mesh. terrain: always build the mesh from DSM/DTM/point cloud. optimize-model: always re-encode the existing model.

quality.title: Quality preset
quality.description: web-light: 150k triangles, 2048 px texture. balanced: 500k triangles, up to 2x2 4096 px textures. high-detail: 1.5M triangles, up to 4x4 4096 px textures. Explicit values below override the preset.

surface_source.title: Surface source
surface_source.description: Which input gives the heights (terrain workflow). auto prefers DSM, then point cloud, then DTM; the others fill gaps.

texture_source.title: Texture source
texture_source.description: auto prefers the orthophoto, then point-cloud colours, then a shaded relief coloured by elevation.

mesh_method.title: Mesh method
mesh_method.description: adaptive: error-driven simplification (RTIN) that keeps detail where the surface changes. grid: a regular grid sized to the triangle budget.

resolution_m.title: Heightfield resolution (m)
resolution_m.description: Node spacing of the surface grid; 0 uses the source resolution (capped so the grid stays within 2049 nodes per side).

max_triangles.title: Triangle budget
max_triangles.description: Upper bound for the mesh; 0 uses the preset.

max_error_m.title: Max vertical error (m)
max_error_m.description: adaptive method: largest allowed deviation of the mesh from the heightfield; 0 picks the smallest error that fits the triangle budget.

texture_size.title: Texture size (px)
texture_size.description: Side of each texture tile (terrain) or cap for existing textures (optimize-model); 0 uses the preset.

texture_tiles.title: Texture tiles per side
texture_tiles.description: terrain: split the model into N x N tiles, each with its own texture; 0 chooses from the orthophoto resolution within the preset's limit.

quantize.title: 16-bit positions
quantize.description: Store vertex positions as 16-bit integers (KHR_mesh_quantization, half the geometry size). Supported by three.js, Cesium, Babylon and Blender; disable for older tools.

fill_holes.title: Fill interior holes
fill_holes.description: Interpolate no-data holes enclosed by data (from the DTM/point cloud when available). Areas outside the survey are never filled.

clip_to_texture.title: Clip to orthophoto
clip_to_texture.description: Drop surface outside the orthophoto's coverage so the model has no untextured fringe.

point_cloud_cell_m.title: Point cloud cell (m)
point_cloud_cell_m.description: Node spacing when the surface comes from the point cloud; 0 chooses about two points per node.

point_cloud_stat.title: Point cloud height statistic
point_cloud_stat.description: Per grid node: max (top surface, like a DSM), mean, or min (rough ground).
